title: Procurement Manager
description:
1 . Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and responsible Procurement & Purchase Manager to manage the complete procurement process for our real estate and construction projects. The candidate will be responsible for purchasing construction materials, coordinating with vendors and suppliers, negotiating prices, ensuring timely delivery, maintaining inventory records, and controlling procurement costs while maintaining quality standards. 
 2.Role & responsibilities 
 1. Purchase & Procurement Handle end-to-end purchasing of construction materials, equipment, tools and other project-related requirements. Procure cement, steel, sand, aggregates, electrical, plumbing and finishing materials. Ensure materials are purchased as per project specifications and requirements. 2. Vendor & Supplier Management Identify, evaluate and develop reliable vendors and suppliers. Maintain strong relationships with existing suppliers. Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery schedules and other commercial conditions. Obtain and compare quotations from multiple vendors. 3. Cost Control & Budget Management Ensure cost-effective purchasing without compromising quality. Prepare purchase budgets and monitor expenses. Identify opportunities for cost savings through negotiation and bulk purchasing. 4. Project Coordination Coordinate with site engineers, project managers, store departments and accounts teams. Understand site material requirements and arrange timely deliveries. Ensure materials are available as per project schedules. 5. Inventory & Documentation Maintain purchase orders, invoices, bills and vendor records. Monitor stock levels and avoid overstocking or material shortages. Verify material receipts and coordinate quality checks. Prepare regular purchase and procurement reports for management. 6. Compliance & Quality Ensure materials meet approved specifications and quality standards. Follow company purchase policies and approval procedures. Maintain proper documentation for audit and financial records. 3. Required Qualifications Graduate in any discipline. Preference for B.Tech / Diploma in Civil Engineering, B.Com, MBA or Supply Chain Management. Knowledge of construction materials and real estate procurement processes. 4. Experience Required Minimum 5-15 years of experience in purchase and procurement. Experience in real estate, construction or infrastructure companies is preferred. Strong knowledge of construction materials, vendor management and market pricing. Experience handling bulk procurement for multiple construction sites will be an advantage. 5. Required Skills Strong negotiation and communication skills. Vendor development and supplier management. Knowledge of construction materials and specifications. Cost analysis and budget management. Inventory and stock management. MS Excel and ERP / purchase management software. Team coordination and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely availability of materials at project sites. Cost savings through effective negotiations. Maintaining material quality standards. Vendor performance and delivery management. Accuracy of purchase documentation. Effective inventory control. 7. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have practical experience in handling procurement operations for real estate or construction projects, possess strong vendor negotiation skills, and be capable of independently managing the complete purchase department.

Key Skills: Vendor Development,Purchase management,Vendor,Procurement,Purchase,Project,Management,Project procurement
